title: 🏗️ Multiple Engineering Roles in Pima County - Up to $37/hr - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Pima County’s engineering scene is buzzing right now, with several solid openings for hands-on problem solvers. Whether you’re into testing, product support, or data systems, there’s something here worth a look.
Product Support Engineer Employer: Cullerton Group
Location: Tucson, AZ
Type: Contract
Pay: Up to $37/hr + full benefits
Work onsite supporting advanced industrial and mining technologies. You’ll troubleshoot hardware and software issues, improve product quality, and collaborate with global teams. A great fit if you like variety and technical challenges.
Hardware Test Engineer (Job ID 002970) Employer: Innovien Solutions
Location: Tucson, AZ
Type: Full-time
Join an aerospace and defense team testing precision-guided systems. This lab-based role focuses on hardware validation, environmental testing, and system integration. Perfect for engineers who enjoy hands-on work and real-time problem solving.
Data Engineer Employer: FetchJobs.co (for Raytheon )
Location: Tucson, AZ
Type: Full-time
Design and test wireless communication and data link systems for defense applications. You’ll work on cutting-edge projects that blend RF, signal processing, and system design. Strong STEM background and coding skills are key.
If you’re ready to grow your engineering career in Tucson, now’s a great time to apply. These roles won’t stay open long—check them out and see which one fits your skills best!
